[[File:GrievousWheelBike-WSMI.png|thumb|right|250px|A Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]]
'''Wheelbikes''' were ground vehicles that employed a single giant wheel. [[Gallis-Tech]] produced the [[48 Roller wheel bike/Legends|48 Roller wheel bike]],<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> and the militarised [[Scout Wheelbike]],<ref name="TC">{{JournalCite|6|The Cure}}</ref> while [[Z-Gomot Ternbuell Guppat Corporation/Legends|Z-Gomot Ternbuell Guppat Corporation]] manufactured the [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]].<ref name="SWCCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
